name: eldercare-fall-ai
description: Fall-detection platform monorepo: orchestration layer only. Dependency locks live per ecosystem (pnpm: front/backend, uv: ml).

scripts.dev:demo: uv run --directory ml --group demo streamlit run demo/app.py
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter front exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter backend exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && uv run --directory ml ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter backend format && uv run --directory ml ruff format .
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate dev
